entry.content:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: v1.1.0: make it closer to the arcade.
Posted: Tue Nov 17, 2026 9:34 am (GMT 0)



Juno First SMS — v1.1.0 Arcade Fidelity Update

The v1.1.0 update brings Juno First significantly closer to Konami's 1983 arcade cabinet, overhauling flight physics, enemy formations, perspective rendering, visual effects, and audio—expanding the ROM to 48 KB ([icode]junofirst.sms[/icode]) to accommodate a dedicated music bank and deeper Z80 assembly optimizations.

🕹️ Arcade Gameplay & Visual Overhaul

* True Momentum & Inertia: Thrust now builds gradually and your ship coasts for several seconds after releasing the controls, requiring deliberate reverse-braking to stop. Lateral steering also carries subtle momentum.
* 24-Enemy Formations: Enemies now spawn in coordinated groups of eight (columns, diagonals, twin columns, and snaking lines) with up to three formations active simultaneously (24 enemies on screen). Individual enemies peel off to dive-bomb your ship before rejoining, while bypassed formations turn around to re-engage.
* True-Perspective Grid & Lanes: Reduced dot clutter by halving row frequency and adding converging dotted column lines toward the horizon, aligning enemy and projectile scaling to true perspective.
* Top-Center Tactical Radar: Added a HUD radar box displaying enemy formations ahead and immediately behind your ship, complete with markers showing the active viewport.
* Upgraded Shots & Particle Explosions: Laser shots now render as dashed beams. Destroying enemies triggers an 8-particle burst, while taking a hit turns the entire field into a dramatic expanding ring of particles centered on your ship.
* Increased Arcade Challenge: Enemies now fire and execute diving attacks starting right from Wave 1.

🎵 Dual Soundtrack & Classical Fanfare

* Arcade-Style Growl Soundtrack: The primary in-game soundtrack is now a menacing 34-second looping bass growl built from two detuned voices creeping chromatically in D minor.
Bach Intro Fanfare: Launching a game opens with the iconic opening bars of Bach's Toccata in D minor*.
* Soundtrack Toggle: The original v1.0.0 extended 4-section melodic theme remains included—press Button 2 on the title screen to switch between the two soundtracks.

⚙️ Engine Optimizations & Technical Details

* Z80 Assembly Hot-Paths: Sprite building ([icode]build_sprites[/icode]), shot loops, and single-sprite emitters were moved into Z80 assembly to handle up to 24 perspective-scaled enemies:
* Normal Play: Runs at full 60 FPS over 99% of the time.
* Heavy Action / Waves 10–11: Holds 97%–98% speed while flying flat-out and firing continuously (dipping only during extreme congestion of 16–20+ simultaneous on-screen enemies).
* Zero Sprite Dropouts: Verified over extended late-wave runs that scanlines never exceed the Master System's 8-sprite hardware limit—enemies never vanish or flicker out.


* ROM & HUD Fixes: Expanded ROM footprint to 48 KB so audio data sits cleanly in its own dedicated bank, and fixed a HUD layout bug where high-score and wave counters overlapped their text labels.
* Deliverables: Includes [icode]junofirst.sms[/icode], [icode]junofirst-src.zip[/icode], a full [icode]README.md[/icode], and [icode]junofirst-screenshot.png[/icode], with all three automated test suites passing in headless emulation.
